My experience covers multiple frameworks across the full stack including: Angular, Vue, Node.js, Java/Springboot, Express, MongoDB, SQL. projects.title: Culturalyst
projects.description:
Platform that allows you to search for and patronize local artists on a one-time or recurring basis in exchange for rewards from them

-Configured marketplace for patronizing artists using Stripe Connect and Node.js
-Created artist profile view with real time data updates using Angular.js, Node.js, and SQLite

projects.title: Bus It Baby
projects.description:
A mobile application that tracks and alerts mass-transit riders when nearing their destination via in-app alarm

-Constructed a hybrid mobile app with Ionic, Angular and Cordova, delivering a native-like experience on iOS/Android with a single codebase
-Integrated Google Maps API and geolocation to integrate public transit routes and to calculate coordinate distances, enabling the app to audibly alert the user when within a user-specified distance of their destination
-Tracked transit data in real time using Firebase open transit API, allowing for accurate tracking of bus lines.
